title: Eleven Weeks
logline: A public health midwife's rounds through a dry-zone village follow several pregnancies at once, each body being assembled week by week, out of sight of everyone but its mother.

object.note: Object 7 (identity not chosen) may appear subtly, for example among Chathura's things while he travels, waits or watches, only where it sits naturally in a real moment. Never staged, never the subject.

thread_in.thread: The body recited from the outside becomes a body built out of sight: a midwife's rounds following pregnancies week by week.

thread_out.thread: From a body being assembled to two bodies at opposite ends of one life: a child growing and a great-grandparent slowing at the same table through one year.

requirements: A rural public health midwife willing to have her rounds filmed
Expectant mothers and families giving full, ongoing consent

suggestions.name: Rural villages served by a public health midwife
suggestions.why: A well-known dry-zone agricultural region with an established rural public health midwife service.

lesson.in_simple_terms: Long before anyone can see it, a new body is being built up bit by bit as several things join in, in order, including the mother's own food. After that it keeps going like a flame, renewed all the time.
lesson.in_simple_terms_si: කිසිවෙකුට නොපෙනෙන කාලයේම, මව ගන්නා ආහාරයද ඇතුළු හේතු කිහිපයක් පිළිවෙළින් එක්වීමෙන් නව ශරීරයක් ක්‍රමයෙන් ගොඩනැගී, පසුව පහන් සිළක් මෙන් නොනැවතී අලුත් වෙමින් පවතින බව අභිධර්මය කියයි.
lesson.the_teaching: The texts describe the matter of a new life joining in a fixed order: matter from past action from the first moment, then mind-born matter, then matter from warmth, and food-born matter once nourishment spreads through the body. A child in the womb receives that nourishment through what the mother eats and drinks. Growth is named among the characteristics of matter: in the Margaya's words, arising before the body is complete is growth, and the repeated arising that replaces what breaks up afterwards is continuity. From then on, the texts say, these streams run unbroken like a lamp flame or a river for as long as life lasts.
lesson.how_the_film_shows_it: The film rides with the midwife between houses, through weighing, checks, quiet advice about food and rest, and the records kept for each pregnancy. The viewer sees only the outside, a mother's meals, a growing shape, a family preparing a room, and comes to feel how much is being built where no one can watch, without any narration describing what happens inside.

key_terms.en: the spreading of nutritive essence through the body

lesson.caution: This is not embryology or a medical timeline, and it must not be drawn into modern debates about reproduction; the texts' stages and dates are traditional teaching.
lesson.builds_on: Where the novices named a finished body part by part, this film follows a body being assembled out of sight, by several makers joining in order.
lesson.evidence_class: editorial interpretation grounded in cited source teaching
